Which size should I choose?

Sizes run from 6oz to 18oz. Lighter weights suit pad speed and smaller hands; 12oz-14oz suits bag and general work; 16oz-18oz is the usual sparring range.

The long lacing track pulls the wrist into a firm, even wrap and keeps the hand aligned during heavy rounds. The trade-off is that someone has to tie them for you, which suits coached sessions and sparring.

Dry cloth on the silver cuffs, a wipe on the black body, and air-dry open after sessions.
